textRuns.value: Can a model predict Yes from a person's profile?

Three algorithms were trained on 7 inputs (age, family size, gender, marital status, occupation, income, education) and tested with nested cross-validation: 50 held-out folds. ROC-AUC 0.5 = coin flip, 1.0 = perfect. Random Forest 0.708, XGBoost 0.704, Logistic Regression 0.638, baseline 0.500. Default model: Logistic Regression (intervals overlap, so the simpler model is preferred).
